body.query: Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?

raw_response.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions_after_2012_01_01
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g
  ON g.gas_station_id = t.gas_station_id
WHERE t.date > DATE '2012-01-01';
raw_response.query: Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?

reason.answer: The query returns a single count of transactions recorded at fuel stations whose transaction date is later than 1 January 2012. The result is one numeric total representing the volume of qualifying post-cutoff activity.
reason.business:
- Identify all recorded fuel-station transactions tied to a known station location.
- Keep only transactions whose date falls after 1 January 2012.
- Count the remaining transactions to produce a single total.
